Shot density on the court

Source: R/shots.R
plot_shot_density.Rd

Where a player (or group) shoots from, as filled density contours, with optional made/missed points on top. With compare, shows the difference between the group's shot density and the reference density (red = shoots there more than the reference), which answers "how is this shot diet different?" rather than "where is the rim?".

Usage

plot_shot_density(
  shots,
  compare = NULL,
  facet = NULL,
  league = NULL,
  points = FALSE,
  bw = 0.6,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

shots

Shot data (see Details in plot_shot_hex()).

compare

Optional reference shots for a density difference map.

facet

Column to facet by (also used for binning).

league

Court to draw; defaults to the league in the data.

points

Overlay individual shots.

bw

Kernel bandwidth in metres.

title, subtitle, caption

Labels. A default subtitle explains the encoding.
